description: This Java class 'SaveCreditReportCommandHandler' handles commands related to saving credit reports in the Fineract credit bureau module. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the save operation to 'CreditReportWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: SaveCreditReportCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that processes commands to save credit reports by invoking a credit report write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles a 'JsonCommand' to save a credit report, invoking the write platform service to perform the save operation.
